<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import type { SeparatorProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SeparatorProps>(), {
  orientation: 'vertical',
});
</script>

<template>
  <Separator
    v-bind="{ ...props, ...delegatedAttrs }"
    data-slot="button-group-separator"
    :class="cn('relative m-0! self-stretch bg-border data-[orientation=vertical]:h-auto', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from 'reka-ui';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const delegatedAttrs = computed(() => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(useAttrs()).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
});

withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps>(), {
  as: 'div',
});

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * Static text or an icon, such as a URL prefix or a unit.
   */
  default?: () => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    v-bind="delegatedAttrs"
    data-slot="button-group-text"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="cn('flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-muted px-4 text-sm font-medium [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*=size-])]:size-4', $attrs.class ?? '')"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>
